description: Multiple-testing ledger (spec §13). Deterministic: no wall-clock; identical rerun => identical file. Experiments are de-duplicated by (alpha_id, kind, canonical config, dataset_version): re-running the same script on the same dataset does not inflate the Bonferroni denominator; the same configuration on a new dataset is a new look, and the looks of earlier datasets are kept (`datasets`). An entry judged under the ledger t-stat policy carries `gate_looks`, the look count its threshold was derived from.
